scope.stationary_replay: Independent functional native CNN and LSTM from zero through every stationary input and the first FREE input; exact recorded cue/reset/override timing.
scope.free_replay: Every saved physical transition, current code, rendered frame, sampled action CDF, and row statistic; full FREE CNN/LSTM histories are not independently rerun.
scope.rendering: Each frame has at least50% independently reconstructed pixels; explicit fixed renderer-boundary exclusions are reported separately. All pixels retain exact archived bytes and tensor hashes.
